content.title: WEIRD SIGNS YOUR BODY IS ACTUALLY MISSING A {{NUTRIENT}}
facts: **Iodine** – Unexplained weight gain, feeling cold all the time, dry skin, and a swollen neck or throat.
**Vitamin K** – Easy bruising, cuts that won't stop bleeding quickly, and bleeding gums when you brush.
**Potassium** – Muscle cramps, irregular heartbeat, fatigue, and a tingling or numb feeling in your limbs.
**Vitamin A** – Night blindness, dry eyes, frequent infections, and rough, bumpy patches on your skin.
**Folate** – Constant tiredness, irritability, pale skin, and a swollen or sore tongue.
**Vitamin E** – Muscle weakness, vision problems, and a wobbly, unsteady way of walking.
**Zinc** – Slow-healing wounds, hair thinning, loss of taste or smell, and frequent colds.
**Omega-3** – Dry, flaky skin, brittle nails, joint stiffness, and trouble focusing.

content.caption:
If you've been feeling off and can't figure out why, it might not be in your head. Iodine deficiency slows your thyroid hormone production, which is why your metabolism feels like it's dragging and you're always reaching for a sweater. Low potassium throws off the electrical signals that keep your heart beating steadily and your muscles firing correctly, which is why cramps and that fluttery heartbeat feeling show up out of nowhere. And folate is essential for making new red blood cells, so when it runs low, your cells can't carry oxygen efficiently, leaving you drained even after a full night's sleep. Everyone's body is different, listen to yours.

At @smarthealthfix, we break down nutrition, common health issues, organs and body functions, and small daily habits so you actually understand what your body is telling you. Our mission is to help you build small, realistic habits instead of chasing quick fixes.
